parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance to which the skill group belongs.

parameters.name: OperationType
parameters.description:
The operation type. Valid values:

- 1: Add. Adds all specified phone numbers to the current outbound phone number list.
- 2: Delete. Removes all specified phone numbers from the current outbound phone number list.
- 3: Reset. Clears the current outbound phone number list and adds all specified phone numbers to the list.
- Other values are invalid and an error is returned.

parameters.name: OutboundPhoneNumberId
parameters.description:
The ID of the outbound phone number to bind to the skill group. 400 numbers do not support outbound calls. Any 400 numbers that are specified are automatically filtered out.

The parameter name **OutboundPhoneNumberId.1** indicates that only one outbound phone number is bound. To bind multiple numbers, specify multiple parameters such as OutboundPhoneNumberId.1, OutboundPhoneNumberId.2, and OutboundPhoneNumberId.3.

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the skill group to modify.
